visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hand holding a beige fleece vest dominates the foreground, showing the soft texture and zipper detail. In the background, an elderly man in a striped polo shirt stands in a brightly lit indoor living room, looking towards the camera with a neutral expression. (2) The man reaches out and takes the vest from the hand. He turns the vest around to inspect it, his glasses reflecting the warm indoor light. He begins to slide his arms into the armholes, his movements slightly hesitant as he figures out the orientation. (3) The man fastens the zipper while looking down at his chest, his fingers fumbling slightly with the small metal tab. Behind him, a ginger cat calmly walks across the polished floor, disappearing into a dimly lit hallway beyond the living area. (4) Realizing the vest is inside out, the man pulls it off over his head, his hair becoming slightly messy. He flips the garment while standing near a bookshelf and a large framed painting on the wall, showing the light beige exterior. (5) He successfully puts the vest on correctly this time, smoothing the fabric over his striped shirt. The room is filled with soft, warm light from overhead fixtures, highlighting the comfortable domestic setting with sofas and home decor in the background. (6) The man poses for the camera, tucking his hands into the side pockets of the new vest. He turns his body to show the profile view, smiling slightly with a sense of quiet satisfaction while looking towards the person filming him. (7) He uses both hands to quickly smooth down his grey hair before raising both arms to give peace signs. His facial expression shifts to a broad, joyful smile, showing high engagement with the camera and the person behind it. (8) The scene cuts to a close-up of a ginger and white cat sniffing the contents of an open blue hardshell suitcase on the floor. The cat eventually turns away and walks towards a dark, reflective glass door or cabinet in the background.
